evidence.summary: Run bounded at 600 s (measured 266 s and 234 s for 218 listings); per-site spacing; refused site gets no further requests in the run or until the pause ends; dead links backed off after 3; Redis outage falls back to a process-local store; poll exceptions are counted, not raised; supervisor restart left all components healthy and the public link healthy (new hostname).

rationale: Limits recorded: solo worker busy about 4 of every 30 min; in-flight Takealot check can overrun by up to 60 s; no Celery hard time limit; pause and failure count not durable until U2 migrations; the full restart changed the public tunnel address.
